summary: Iteration 12 - Verified all 3 Next-Action-Items: Taxonomy hierarchy, Excel import preview/validate, and Varemottak open-orders panel. BACKEND: 10/10 pytest cases PASS (test_iteration12.py). Verified: (1) GET /items/taxonomy returns {categories:[{name, main_groups:[{name, sub_groups:[]}]}]} with at least 1 category and includes 'Klær' once items exist; (2) GET /items/import/template returns valid xlsx (>5000 bytes) with 'Varer' + 'Instruksjoner' sheets, 12 header columns ending with 'Leverandørnr', first data row 'Kjegler', and supplier list in Instruksjoner incl. 00001; (3) POST /items/import/preview with template returns {ok:true, items:3, total_items:3, total_variants:4, errors:[]} and matches 'Håndball Select' to supplier 00001 Select Sport AS; (4) Invalid Type 'xyz' -> errors with field='Type' error referencing valid types; (5) Non-existent Leverandørnr 99999 -> errors field='Leverandørnr' error 'finnes ikke'; (6) Missing Kategori -> errors field='Kategori' error='Kategori er påkrevd'; (7) POST /items/import commits 3 items; Håndball Select has supplier_id, supplier_number='00001', supplier_name='Select Sport AS', 2 size variants; (8) GET /items/{id}/open-orders returns {orders:[]} for item with no PO; (9) Returns orders array w/ order_id, po_number, supplier_name, size, jersey_number, ordered, received, remaining, line_status, status on item with open PO; (10) Filters out orders with status='levert' (verified via /orders/{oid}/manual-status). FRONTEND via playwright on prod URL: /app/utstyr 'Nytt utstyr' dialog opens with cat-select, mg-select, sg-select testids and cat-add-btn, mg-add-btn, sg-add-btn. Clicking cat-add-btn switches to cat-custom-input (visible=true). 'Importer Excel' button present. /app/varemottak: varemottak-page loads, 12 pick buttons present; picking item (Hjemmedrakt S) shows no-open-orders testid with text 'Ingen åpne bestillinger for denne varen (str 164).' as expected (demo tenant has no open PO for that variant). Backend tests already cover the populated-panel case. React duplicate-key console warnings persist on all pages (carried over from iter 11, already reported).

ui_bugs.issue: React 'Encountered two children with the same key' warning fires repeatedly (10+ times per page). Reported in iter_11 and NOT yet fixed. Non-blocking but should fix map keys (likely composite key item_id+variant_id+size).

action_items: LOW (unresolved from iter_11): Fix React duplicate-key warnings on grouped item/variant lists. Use composite key e.g. `${item.id}-${variant.size}-${variant.jersey_number}` in Inventory.jsx and Varemottak.jsx.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still 5256 lines – iter_11 recommendation to split into modules remains unaddressed. P1 in backlog per request.

items_import endpoint ALWAYS INSERTS, never updates. _parse_import_rows computes `_will_update` and `_existing_id` from existing_names, but items_import() just inserts the doc – resulting in duplicate items with same name/category. If 'Hjemmedrakt' already exists and user re-imports template, two 'Hjemmedrakt' documents will exist. Either (a) honor _will_update and do upsert via existing_id, or (b) add validation rejecting duplicate names when not strict, or (c) remove the misleading _will_update field.

items_import endpoint silently ignores validation errors by default (non-strict). The default UX is dangerous: if user has 50 bad rows and 10 good ones, 50 rows are silently dropped and user only sees 'created: 10'. Preview flow mitigates this in UI but a direct API caller could lose data. Consider defaulting strict=True.

/items/taxonomy builds tree only from existing items. Empty tenants (no items yet) return `{categories: []}` and 'Nytt utstyr' dialog will have NO options at all – forcing user to use the '+ ny kategori' path. Consider seeding a few default categories (Klær, Baller, Utstyr) or returning common defaults when tree is empty.

/items/{id}/open-orders final_statuses set includes 'levert', 'arkivert', 'annullert' but NOT 'manko' or 'restbestilling' – is that intentional? A 'manko' order may still be partially open – OK to keep but worth a code comment explaining.

ImportPreviewDialog.jsx uploads file twice (preview + commit). If user edits original Excel between preview and commit click, backend will import the edited version silently. Consider either (a) passing preview grouped-dict to a /items/import/commit endpoint with a token, or (b) hashing filename+mtime in preview response.

TaxonomyPicker + button is a one-way switch: once user clicks '+ ny kategori' they cannot go back to the dropdown without reopening the dialog. Add a small 'x' or 'tilbake' button to revert to dropdown mode.

rca of the issue: N/A - no critical bugs. The main concerns are the silent duplicate-item creation on re-import (items_import always inserts), and the empty-taxonomy UX gap for brand new tenants. Neither blocks the current iteration's feature set but should be addressed before public release.
